observations.title: Collect merged experience orbs
observations.player_action: Approach experience drops clustered in a small area.
observations.outcome: Nearby XP orbs are grouped into fewer entities and are collected immediately on contact.
conditions: For Minecraft 1.17 and newer the author specifies server-side installation; this does not imply an XP multiplier.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
